claim: Hook h1/h2 + captions: the idea of removing 'kerugian negara' from the corruption definition was reported after Luhut's 20 Oct remarks; Luhut later (written statement 21 Oct, ~19:00-21:00 WIB) said it is not removed; KPK objected on 21 Oct (before the clarification, h2 now 'Lalu kenapa KPK keberatan?' (no 'sempat': no source says KPK changed its position; Budi Prasetyo's statement ran 20:21, after the clarification)).

l1: On Tue 20 Oct 2026 at the Istana (after a limited meeting at Istana Merdeka), Luhut (Ketua DEN) said the President agreed with DEN's study on the definition of corruption. Approval is Luhut's account only: no direct Prabowo or Palace spokesperson quote found.

l2: Per Luhut, the UN definition ('UN Charter' in his words; articles identify it as UNCAC) focuses on bribery and does not talk about state loss; the current rule burdens Danantara in executing business.

l4 + captions + pinned #3: UU 31/1999 (jo. UU 20/2001) Pasal 2(1): unlawfully enriching oneself/another/a corporation; Pasal 3: abusing authority, opportunity or means due to position; both 'yang (dapat) merugikan keuangan negara atau perekonomian negara' (MK 25/PUU-XIV/2016 struck 'dapat'). Since the KUHP Nasional (UU 1/2023) took effect on 2 Jan 2026, Pasal 622 revoked Pasal 2(1) and 3 UU Tipikor and moved them to KUHP Pasal 603 and 604, which keep the state-finance-loss element. Spoken: 'sejak 2026 pindah ke KUHP baru (Pasal 603 dan 604)'.

l5: UNCAC Art. 3(2): it is not necessary for the offences to result in damage or harm to state property. Its criminalisation chapter (Art. 15-23) lists acts: bribery of national/foreign officials, embezzlement, trading in influence, abuse of functions, illicit enrichment, private-sector bribery/embezzlement, money laundering. Indonesia ratified via UU 7/2006 (caption/pinned only).

l6: Ketua KPK Setyo Budiyanto (21 Oct): state loss should stay (even restored as lex specialis, in line with an MK ruling); more urgent is criminalising offences not yet in UU Tipikor: foreign bribery, trading in influence, private-sector bribery, illicit enrichment. KPK spokesperson Budi Prasetyo: 'diskursus kerugian keuangan negara sudah firm'.

l7 (verdicts predate the new KUHP, so 'Pasal 2 dan 3' is correct here): ICW (Wana Alamsyah, 21 Oct) monitoring of 2024 corruption verdicts: about 83% of defendants were sentenced under Pasal 2 and 3 UU Tipikor (reporter paraphrase of ICW data).

l8: Criminal-law expert Trisno Raharjo (UMY), 21 Oct 13:38: agrees losses from legitimate business decisions should not be criminalised, but says that is no reason to delete or change the provision ('tidak menjadikan penghapusan aturan atau mengubah'); script: 'tapi itu bukan alasan menghapus pasalnya'. Headline word 'mengada-ada' is Suara's, not used.

l9: Luhut's written clarification (21 Oct): 'Kerugian keuangan negara tetap menjadi unsur dalam UU Tipikor'; DEN proposes clearer, objective proof and a policy/business judgment rule protecting good-faith, procedural decisions (excluding embezzlement, bribery, self-enrichment); also adopting UNCAC offences not yet in law and an omnibus law on state finances.

l10 + captions: Yusril (21 Oct, Istana): Luhut's idea 'layak dipertimbangkan' (CNBC); 'belum ada masuk Prolegnas kalau enggak salah ya' (Liputan6). CNBC narration: still a wacana, no UU Tipikor revision planned yet. Menkum Supratman: 'Nanti pasti akan dibahas ... kita tunggu arahan presiden'. 'Belum ada draf RUU yang diumumkan': no RUU, naskah akademik or draft reported in any source read or found by search as of 22 Okt (fact-check #11).

CTA + vote chips: 'Pasal kerugian negara: Tim sudah cukup atau Tim perlu diperbaiki?' (opinion question, not a factual claim; replaces the false binary 'tetap vs diubah', since Luhut now also says the element stays). YouTube title adds 'Klarifikasi Luhut'.
